note: Access Bank's rates guide for personal accounts: its savings accounts carry no account maintenance charge (their quarterly debit card maintenance fee of 53.75 naira belongs to the card, and the 50 naira levy to transfers). Its Individual Current account's maintenance fee is 1 naira per thousand of debit turnover, a charge on spending that the game doesn't count, so the savings account is taken. Read again 2026-10-30: Instant Savings pays 6.90% a year; its debit card costs 53.75 naira a quarter (VAT included), now written as the card's fee; Access ATMs are free, another bank's 107.5 naira; an instant (NIP) transfer to another bank is 10 naira plus 7.5% VAT up to 5,000 naira (10.75, the tier written), 25 plus VAT to 50,000 and 50 plus VAT above; to another Access account nothing. Not stated for this account: overdraft, a returned payment, its card abroad (the international columns are for other cards), what opening asks.
